package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
)

func (store Store) GetActivePolicyBundle(ctx context.Context) (domain.PolicyBundle, error) {
	var generationConfig []byte
	var pedagogyCode, presentationCode, generationCode string
	var pedagogyVersion, presentationVersion, generationVersion int
	err := store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT activation.pedagogy_profile_code, activation.pedagogy_profile_version,
       activation.presentation_style_code, activation.presentation_style_version,
       activation.generation_policy_code, activation.generation_policy_version,
       generation.config_json
FROM planner_policy_activation activation
JOIN pedagogy_profile_version pedagogy
  ON pedagogy.code=activation.pedagogy_profile_code
 AND pedagogy.version=activation.pedagogy_profile_version
JOIN presentation_style_version presentation
  ON presentation.code=activation.presentation_style_code
 AND presentation.version=activation.presentation_style_version
JOIN generation_policy_version generation
  ON generation.code=activation.generation_policy_code
 AND generation.version=activation.generation_policy_version
WHERE activation.slot='course_planning'
  AND pedagogy.status='PUBLISHED'
  AND presentation.status='PUBLISHED'
  AND generation.status='PUBLISHED'`).Scan(
		&pedagogyCode, &pedagogyVersion, &presentationCode, &presentationVersion,
		&generationCode, &generationVersion, &generationConfig,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PolicyBundle{}, err
	}
	var config struct {
		MasterySkipConfidence  float64 `json:"mastery_skip_confidence"`
		LessonPersonalization  bool    `json:"lesson_personalization"`
		ExamplePersonalization bool    `json:"example_personalization"`
		TaskPersonalization    bool    `json:"task_personalization"`
		TestPersonalization    bool    `json:"test_personalization"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(generationConfig, &config); err != nil {
		return domain.PolicyBundle{}, err
	}
	rows, err := store.Pool.Query(ctx, `
SELECT binding.strategy_code, binding.strategy_version, binding.priority, strategy.config_json
FROM pedagogy_profile_strategy binding
JOIN pedagogy_strategy_version strategy
  ON strategy.code=binding.strategy_code AND strategy.version=binding.strategy_version
WHERE binding.profile_code=$1 AND binding.profile_version=$2
  AND binding.enabled=true AND strategy.status='PUBLISHED'
ORDER BY binding.priority DESC, binding.strategy_code, binding.strategy_version`, pedagogyCode, pedagogyVersion)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PolicyBundle{}, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	strategies := make([]domain.PedagogyStrategyVersion, 0)
	for rows.Next() {
		var strategy domain.PedagogyStrategyVersion
		if err := rows.Scan(&strategy.Code, &strategy.Version, &strategy.Priority, &strategy.Config); err != nil {
			return domain.PolicyBundle{}, err
		}
		strategies = append(strategies, strategy)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return domain.PolicyBundle{}, err
	}
	return domain.NormalizePolicyBundle(domain.PolicyBundle{
		PlannerVersion:         domain.PlannerVersion,
		PedagogyProfile:        versionIdentity(pedagogyCode, pedagogyVersion),
		PresentationStyle:      versionIdentity(presentationCode, presentationVersion),
		GenerationPolicy:       versionIdentity(generationCode, generationVersion),
		MasterySkipConfidence:  config.MasterySkipConfidence,
		LessonPersonalization:  config.LessonPersonalization,
		ExamplePersonalization: config.ExamplePersonalization,
		TaskPersonalization:    config.TaskPersonalization,
		TestPersonalization:    config.TestPersonalization,
		PedagogyStrategies:     strategies,
	})
}

func versionIdentity(code string, version int) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s-v%d", code, version)
}

var _ repository.PolicyRepository = Store{}
